description.value: BLVD Bistro is a beloved brunch destination in Queensbury Village on the North Shore of Vancouver, sister restaurant to S'wich Cafe and open since 2015. The menu leans creative and internationally inflected — think Paella Del Patron, Chilaquiles, and a Brisket Burnt Ends Poutine — built around locally sourced and environmentally responsible ingredients. The restaurant is walk-in only with no reservations accepted, and has a garden out back.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active and confirms BLVD Bistro is a real, operating brunch restaurant at 636 Queensbury Ave, North Vancouver, matching the OSM address and website URL. No evidence for bike parking, washrooms, takeout, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags. A recurring address inconsistency exists where the website sidebar widget shows '36 Queensbury Ave' while the footer and contact page main content both show the correct '636 Queensbury Ave', consistent with OSM — this appears to be a template/CMS error rather than a genuine address conflict.
concerns: Website sidebar/contact widget repeatedly shows '36 Queensbury Ave' instead of '636 Queensbury Ave'; footer and main contact page both show the correct '636' address matching OSM — appears to be a CMS template error.
No phone number available in OSM or on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, openly operating brunch restaurant with an active website and consistent location data; publicly accessible and useful to touring cyclists seeking a meal stop.
